consequence: For a q=5 apartment-code word of weight 625, each chart type P or L is either heavy-free with A_type=250, or has A_type<=240. Pass5102 minimum-cut rigidity says a nonstar minimum word must have a heavy chart in at least one type. Therefore any nonstar weight-625 word has total active-chart count A<=490. The old candidate (h8,h9)=(2,1), A_type=248 is impossible.
improvement: The previous Pass5127 equality-shell bound was A<=498 for a nonstar weight-625 word. This tensor-component theorem improves the forced active-chart deficit from 2 to at least 10 in the heavy type, hence from total A<=498 to total A<=490.
boundary: This eliminates the previously minimal exotic coarea profile and sharply widens the active-chart gap, but it does not yet rule out all nonstar weight-625 words. The full q=5/all-q apartment-code minimum-distance theorem is not claimed here.
